#### What type of PR is this?
/kind bug
<!--
Add one of the following kinds:
/kind bug
/kind cleanup
/kind documentation
/kind feature

Optionally add one or more of the following kinds if applicable:
/kind api-change
/kind deprecation
/kind failing-test
/kind flake
/kind regression
-->

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
Webhook request spans only show spanName as `GET`/`POST`. Following the open-telemetry standard of spanName, it's recommended to use `Method + Host` as spanName.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/10649416/186878474-7cc8ad7b-78af-44b9-b35f-e62df3c5de38.png)

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/112059

After:

issue_context.title: Tracing: precise spanName of apiserver webhook requests
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

When enable apiserver tracing, the webhook request spans only show spanName as `GET`/`POST`,  mostly because `opentelemetry-go v0.20.0` use http request operations as default span name, https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-go-contrib/blob/v0.20.0/instrumentation/net/http/otelhttp/handler.go#L54-L56
 which is hard to understand. ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/10649416/186877756-cd7e6486-0c86-4a2b-b5a6-835ea953f7c1.png)

Following the open-telemetry standard of spanName, it's recommended to use `Method + Host` as spanName.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/10649416/186878474-7cc8ad7b-78af-44b9-b35f-e62df3c5de38.png)


### What did you expect to happen?

SpanName of webhook request should be `Method + Host`, like 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/10649416/186880111-20bd1a7a-0aeb-4a5e-b1da-4d1466ed8c8a.png)


### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

1. enable APIServerTracing feature gates of apiserver
2. create a pod
3. check tracing dashboard

### Anything else we need to know?

_No response_

I test locally by 1.29 kubernetes and start a sample webhook, looks like the client span has already conforms to semantic conventions https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/blob/v1.1.0/specification/trace/semantic_conventions/http.md#name , which should be in the form of "HTTP {METHOD_NAME}"

![image](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/assets/11855957/9276afba-5d87-4154-bed7-8a40f8df4479)
For apiserver as a server, now the spanName is still KubernetesAPI, which I think we could enhance it into "HTTP get_account/{accountId}" format
@dashpole After digging for a while, I found one solution to implement this, I draft this idea in #123584 , could you help review about whether this is a correct way to implement it?

review_comments: We should avoid including the full host here.  See https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-specification/blob/v1.1.0/specification/trace/semantic_conventions/http.md#name.  It may be better to fix this in upstream otel than to fix it here as well.
